svg.title: Order-to-Cash — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN collaboration with an external customer and Charles River Sales, Warehouse, Customer Accounting, and Treasury lanes. Unavailable goods remain open; available goods proceed to shipment, invoice, receipt, and cash application.
